description: R.R.N. Wijegunawardene v. K. Don Leslie Bandula Kumarasiri and Others R.R.N. Wijegunawardene v. K. Don Leslie Bandula Kumarasiri and Others View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: R.R.N. Wijegunawardene v. K. Don Leslie Bandula Kumarasiri and Others R.R.N. Wijegunawardene v. K. Don Leslie Bandula Kumarasiri and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s refusal to set aside a judgment and final decree entered in a partition action. The Court noted that objections to the final survey should have been made within 30 days under Section 48(4) of the Partition Act No 21 of 1977, but the application was made about seven months later. Held - Appeal and/or revision application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
